title: TipsInteractionCancelledPayload
description: tips.interaction.cancelled v1 (OpenVibe.Tips server/domain/interactions.js failPayment, cancelQueued). Undelivered effects were cancelled: the payment failed before settling (reason payment_failed, with the Billing error code), Billing reversed it (payment_reversed) or an effect came up while the payment was no longer settled (payment_not_settled). Envelope: subject { type: interaction, id: tint_… }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:tips. Never emitted for tests or imports.

supporter.description: The supporter, null when external, anonymous or unmapped.

amount.description: Integer amount in currency minor units (Vibes bits).

billing_txn_id.description: The Billing transaction (txn_…) that settled it.

test.description: Simulations never emit events, so false in practice.

code.description: Only with reason payment_failed: the Billing problem code (billing.insufficient_funds, billing.funding_reversed, billing.refused…).
